messages.topic: VIP & Gated Commands Verification Architecture & Payment Fail-Safe
messages.message: Awesome work on the multi-page split and NextAuth fix! Veer asked how the bot will verify (1) joining his HQ server, (2) BMC tipping/roles, (3) YouTube subscription, and what fail-safes exist if someone pays but automation fails. Designed the 3-tier verification: (1) Discord HQ membership verified via Discord.js guild cache instantly; (2) BMC supporter via native BMC Discord role sync + MongoDB fallback with /claim-perks and /vip grant master override so nobody ever loses access; (3) YouTube subscription via community proof role or 1-click channel link button. Frontend may soon display a /claim or /verify portal if requested.
